world.frame: Local east-north-up: x=east, y=north, z=up, metres (see layout.py's module docstring -- algebraically the same right-handed axes as a vehicle's own ISO 8855 frame; the world is oriented so the main spawn's forward is east).
world.note: Square world, x and y each in [-half_extent_m, +half_extent_m].

precision: Evaluate in IEEE-754 double precision throughout (matches ps::real = double, PLAN.md D4). The hash is exact-integer (uint32_t wraparound); only the final hash-to-float division is floating point.

hash.name: murmur3_fmix32_seeded
hash.reference: MurmurHash3 fmix32 finalizer (public domain, Austin Appleby), with an added seeded lattice-coordinate mix before the finaliser.

value_noise.description: Bilinear interpolation of the 4 surrounding lattice values, using the fractional coordinate remapped by smoothstep(t) = t*t*(3-2*t) on both axes (standard Hermite smoothstep, applied to x then y).
value_noise.formula: gx=x/wavelength; gy=y/wavelength; ix0=floor(gx); iy0=floor(gy); fx=gx-ix0; fy=gy-iy0; sx=smoothstep(fx); sy=smoothstep(fy); a=lerp(v(ix0,iy0),v(ix0+1,iy0),sx); b=lerp(v(ix0,iy0+1),v(ix0+1,iy0+1),sx); noise=lerp(a,b,sy)

height_noise.formula: sum(amplitude_k * value_noise(x, y, wavelength_k, seed + seed_offset_k)) over ROLLING_OCTAVES, plus roughness(x,y) * hill.amplitude * value_noise(x,y,hill.wavelength,seed+hill.seed_offset)

roughness.formula: 0 at/inside near_radius_m, 1 at/beyond far_radius_m, smoothstep(dist_from_origin) in between

flat_zones.description: height(x,y) = height_noise(x,y) * (1 - flat_mask(x,y)); flat_mask is the max over every zone below of: 1 inside the zone, smoothstep-blended to 0 over the zone's own blend width outside it.

surface_rules.description: Surface is a *per-cell* property, one id per (tile_x, tile_y) cell at tiling.tile_size_m granularity: tile_x=floor(x/tile_size_m), tile_y=floor(y/tile_size_m); a cell's surface is these rules evaluated at its centre point ((tile_x+0.5)*tile_size_m, (tile_y+0.5)*tile_size_m) -- never at an arbitrary point, so every point in a cell agrees. This is the fill surface of the open terrain only; a meshed test feature's own footprint (always on a flat zone, above) is covered by that mesh's own per-triangle collision surface instead (test_ground_collision.json) -- the two are never blended. Rules evaluated in order, first whose channel value >= 'min' wins; default is 'grass' if none match. Each rule's channel is value_noise(cell_cx,cell_cy,wavelength,seed+seed_offset), renormalised from [-1,1] to [0,1] before the threshold.

tiling.note: 256 m tiles are both the height-mesh LOD unit (suggestion, not a requirement: 1 m vertex spacing within lod_near_radius_m of the player/camera, coarsening towards sample_spacing_far_m with distance; regenerate/re-mesh a tile deterministically from (tile_x, tile_y, seed), no persisted state needed) and the surface-id cell size (a requirement -- see surface_rules).

surface_params_ref: data/surfaces/surfaces.json: physical lambda_mu/crr values for every surface id used here (grass, dirt, field) or by the feature meshes (asphalt, kerb, low_mu) -- one shared table, not duplicated per source (PLAN.md P11: a later real-world land-cover source maps onto the same ids).
